name: zen-notes-widget
description: Personal multi-note sidebar with a minimal header, floating formatting toolbar, and drag-to-collapse
author: jjspscl
features: Lean pinned sidebar widget above workspace indicators
Bold, italic, underline, and strikethrough formatting
Bullet, numbered, and checklist formatting with markdown shortcuts
Links with an http/https/mailto scheme allowlist
Legacy v1/v4 migration into the schema v5 note library
Inline note manager for creating, renaming and deleting
Drag or keyboard resize, collapse and expand
